verses.ar: اِقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away

verses.ar: مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ مُّحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا اسۡتَمَعُوۡهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Never comes (aught) to them of a renewed Message from their Lord, but they listen to it as in jest

verses.ar: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوۡبُهُمۡؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجۡوَيࣗۖ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاࣗۖ هَلۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۚ اَفَتَاۡتُوۡنَ السِّحۡرَ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open

verses.ar: قٰلَ رَبِّيۡ يَعۡلَمُ الۡقَوۡلَ فِي السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؗ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: Say: "My Lord knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth: He is the One that heareth and knoweth (all things)

verses.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَضۡغَاثُ اَحۡلَامٍۭ بَلِ افۡتَرٰىهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۚۖ فَلۡيَاۡتِنَا بِاٰيَةٍ كَمَا٘ اُرۡسِلَ الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old

verses.ar: مَا٘ اٰمَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهَاۚ اَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: (As to those) before them, not one of the populations which We destroyed believed: will these believe

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فَسۡـَٔلُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلَ الذِّكۡرِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Before thee, also, the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: If ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ جَسَدًا لَّا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوۡا خٰلِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: Nor did We give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they exempt from death

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنٰهُمُ الۡوَعۡدَ فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُمۡ وَمَنۡ نَّشَآءُ وَاَهۡلَكۡنَا الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
verses.en: In the end We fulfilled to them Our Promise, and We saved them and those whom We pleased, but We destroyed those who transgressed beyond bounds

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتٰبًا فِيۡهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: We have revealed for you (O men!) a book in which is a Message for you: will ye not then understand

verses.ar: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةً وَّاَنۡشَاۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ
verses.en: How many were the populations We utterly destroyed because of their iniquities, setting up in their places other peoples

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَحَسُّوۡا بَاۡسَنَا٘ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it

verses.ar: لَا تَرۡكُضُوۡا وَارۡجِعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي مَا٘ اُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ وَمَسٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Ah! woe to us! We were indeed wrong-doers

verses.ar: فَمَا زَالَتۡ تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوٰىهُمۡ حَتّٰي جَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ حَصِيۡدًا خٰمِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is mown, as ashes silent and quenched

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: Not for (idle) sport did We create the heavens and the earth and all that is between

verses.ar: لَوۡ اَرَدۡنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوًا لَّاتَّخَذۡنٰهُ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا٘ࣗۖ اِنۡ كُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: If it had been Our wish to take (just) a pastime, We should surely have taken it from the things nearest to Us, if We would do (such a thing)

verses.ar: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِالۡحَقِّ عَلَي الۡبَاطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهٗ فَاِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌؕ وَلَكُمُ الۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us)

verses.ar: وَلَهٗ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَنۡ عِنۡدَهٗ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: To Him belong all (creatures) in the heavens and on earth: Even those who are in His (very) Presence are not too proud to serve Him, nor are they (ever) weary (of His service)

verses.ar: يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They celebrate His praises night and day, nor do they ever flag or intermit

verses.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡ٘ا اٰلِهَةً مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنۡشِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)

verses.ar: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيۡهِمَا٘ اٰلِهَةٌ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: If there were, in the heavens and the earth, other gods besides Allah, there would have been confusion in both! but glory to Allah, the Lord of the Throne: (High is He) above what they attribute to Him

verses.ar: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs)

verses.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةًؕ قُلۡ هَاتُوۡا بُرۡهَانَكُمۡۚ هٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَنۡ مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَنۡ قَبۡلِيۡؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ الۡحَقَّ فَهُمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or have they taken for worship (other) gods besides him? Say, "Bring your convincing proof: this is the Message of those with me and the Message of those before me." But most of them know not the Truth, and so turn away

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا نُوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنَا فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
verses.en: Not a messenger did We send before thee without this inspiration sent by Us to him: that there is no god but I; therefore worship and serve Me

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ بَلۡ عِبَادٌ مُّكۡرَمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And they say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten offspring." Glory to Him! they are (but) servants raised to honour

verses.ar: لَا يَسۡبِقُوۡنَهٗ بِالۡقَوۡلِ وَهُمۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command

verses.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُوۡنَۙ اِلَّا لِمَنِ ارۡتَضٰي وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهٖ مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory)

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اِلٰهٌ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ فَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡهِ جَهَنَّمَؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: If any of them should say, "I am a god besides Him", such a one We should reward with Hell: thus do We reward those who do wrong

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقًا فَفَتَقۡنٰهُمَاؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ الۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّؕ اَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنۡ تَمِيۡدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We have set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways (between mountains) for them to pass through: that they may receive Guidance

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا السَّمَآءَ سَقۡفًا مَّحۡفُوۡظًاۚۖ وَّهُمۡ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We have made the heavens as a canopy well guarded: yet do they turn away from the Signs which these things (point to)

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَؕ كُلٌّ فِيۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ الۡخُلۡدَؕ اَفَا۠ئِنۡ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الۡخٰلِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: We granted not to any man before thee permanent life (here): if then thou shouldst die, would they live permanently

verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِؕ وَنَبۡلُوۡكُمۡ بِالشَّرِّ وَالۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةًؕ وَاِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Every soul shall have a taste of death: and We test you by evil and by good by way of trial. to Us must ye return

verses.ar: وَاِذَا رَاٰكَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِيۡ يَذۡكُرُ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡۚ وَهُمۡ بِذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: When the Unbelievers see thee, they treat thee not except with ridicule. "Is this," (they say), "the one who talks of your gods?" and they blaspheme at the mention of (Allah) Most Gracious

verses.ar: خُلِقَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِنۡ عَجَلٍؕ سَاُورِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنِ
verses.en: Man is a creature of haste: soon (enough) will I show you My Signs; then ye will not ask Me to hasten them

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if ye are telling the truth

verses.ar: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا حِيۡنَ لَا يَكُفُّوۡنَ عَنۡ وُّجُوۡهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَنۡ ظُهُوۡرِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: If only the Unbelievers knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the fire from their faces, nor yet from their backs, and (when) no help can reach them

verses.ar: بَلۡ تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ بَغۡتَةً فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ اسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِيۡنَ سَخِرُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ يَّكۡلَؤُكُمۡ بِالَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اٰلِهَةٌ تَمۡنَعُهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِنَاؕ لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us

verses.ar: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡعُمُرُؕ اَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ اَنَّا نَاۡتِي الۡاَرۡضَ نَنۡقُصُهَا مِنۡ اَطۡرَافِهَاؕ اَفَهُمُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اُنۡذِرُكُمۡ بِالۡوَحۡيِؗۖ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا مَا يُنۡذَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٌ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ يٰوَيۡلَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed

verses.ar: وَنَضَعُ الۡمَوَازِيۡنَ الۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَاِنۡ كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ اَتَيۡنَا بِهَاؕ وَكَفٰي بِنَا حٰسِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰي وَهٰرُوۡنَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَّذِكۡرًا لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: In the past We granted to Moses and Aaron the criterion (for judgment), and a Light and a Message for those who would do right

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَهُمۡ مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who fear their Lord in their most secret thoughts, and who hold the Hour (of Judgment) in awe

verses.ar: وَهٰذَا ذِكۡرٌ مُّبٰرَكٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُؕ اَفَاَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ رُشۡدَهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا بِهٖ عٰلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: We bestowed aforetime on Abraham his rectitude of conduct, and well were We acquainted with him

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَا هٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيۡلُ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا عٰكِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Behold! he said to his father and his people, "What are these images, to which ye are (so assiduously) devoted

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا لَهَا عٰبِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاٰبَآؤُكُمۡ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: He said, "Indeed ye have been in manifest error - ye and your fathers

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَجِئۡتَنَا بِالۡحَقِّ اَمۡ اَنۡتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, "Have you brought us the Truth, or are you one of those who jest

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ رَّبُّكُمۡ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَهُنَّؗۖ وَاَنَا عَلٰي ذٰلِكُمۡ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said, "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He Who created them (from nothing): and I am a witness to this (Truth)

verses.ar: وَتَاللّٰهِ لَاَكِيۡدَنَّ اَصۡنَامَكُمۡ بَعۡدَ اَنۡ تُوَلُّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: And by Allah, I have a plan for your idols - after ye go away and turn your backs

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ جُذٰذًا اِلَّا كَبِيۡرًا لَّهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: So he broke them to pieces, (all) but the biggest of them, that they might turn (and address themselves) to it

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا مَنۡ فَعَلَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا٘ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? He must indeed be some man of impiety

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سَمِعۡنَا فَتًي يَّذۡكُرُهُمۡ يُقَالُ لَهٗ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُؕ‏
verses.en: They said, "We heard a youth talk of them: He is called Abraham

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا فَاۡتُوۡا بِهٖ عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاَنۡتَ فَعَلۡتَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا يٰ٘اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُؕ‏
verses.en: They said, "Art thou the one that did this with our gods, O Abraham

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ فَعَلَهٗࣗۖ كَبِيۡرُهُمۡ هٰذَا فَسۡـَٔلُوۡهُمۡ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "Nay, this was done by - this is their biggest one! ask them, if they can speak intelligently

verses.ar: فَرَجَعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّكُمۡ اَنۡتُمُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So they turned to themselves and said, "Surely ye are the ones in the wrong

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوۡا عَلٰي رُءُوۡسِهِمۡۚ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then were they confounded with shame: (they said), "Thou knowest full well that these (idols) do not speak

verses.ar: قَالَ اَفَتَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنۡفَعُكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يَضُرُّكُمۡؕ‏
verses.en: (Abraham) said, "Do ye then worship, besides Allah, things that can neither be of any good to you nor do you harm

verses.ar: اُفٍّ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا حَرِّقُوۡهُ وَانۡصُرُوۡ٘ا اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, "Burn him and protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all)

verses.ar: قُلۡنَا يٰنَارُ كُوۡنِيۡ بَرۡدًا وَّسَلٰمًا عَلٰ٘ي اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَۙ‏
verses.en: We said, "O Fire! be thou cool, and (a means of) safety for Abraham

verses.ar: وَاَرَادُوۡا بِهٖ كَيۡدًا فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ وَلُوۡطًا اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَا لِلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: But We delivered him and (his nephew) Lut (and directed them) to the land which We have blessed for the nations

verses.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اِسۡحٰقَؕ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ نَافِلَةًؕ وَكُلًّا جَعَلۡنَا صٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We bestowed on him Isaac and, as an additional gift, (a grandson), Jacob, and We made righteous men of every one (of them)

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَئِمَّةً يَّهۡدُوۡنَ بِاَمۡرِنَا وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فِعۡلَ الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَاِقَامَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَاِيۡتَآءَ الزَّكٰوةِۚ وَكَانُوۡا لَنَا عٰبِدِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And We made them leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We sent them inspiration to do good deeds, to establish regular prayers, and to practise regular charity; and they constantly served Us (and Us only)

verses.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اٰتَيۡنٰهُ حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًا وَّنَجَّيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡقَرۡيَةِ الَّتِيۡ كَانَتۡ تَّعۡمَلُ الۡخَبٰٓئِثَؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٍ فٰسِقِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And to Lut, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, and We saved him from the town which practised abominations: truly they were a people given to Evil, a rebellious people

verses.ar: وَاَدۡخَلۡنٰهُ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And We admitted him to Our Mercy: for he was one of the Righteous

verses.ar: وَنُوۡحًا اِذۡ نَادٰي مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗ فَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ وَاَهۡلَهٗ مِنَ الۡكَرۡبِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۚ‏
verses.en: (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress

verses.ar: وَنَصَرۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٍ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
verses.en: We helped him against people who rejected Our Signs: truly they were a people given to Evil: so We drowned them (in the Flood) all together

verses.ar: وَدَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيۡمٰنَ اِذۡ يَحۡكُمٰنِ فِي الۡحَرۡثِ اِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيۡهِ غَنَمُ الۡقَوۡمِۚ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شٰهِدِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the matter of the field into which the sheep of certain people had strayed by night: We did witness their judgment

verses.ar: فَفَهَّمۡنٰهَا سُلَيۡمٰنَۚ وَكُلًّا اٰتَيۡنَا حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًاؗ وَّسَخَّرۡنَا مَعَ دَاوٗدَ الۡجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحۡنَ وَالطَّيۡرَؕ وَكُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: To Solomon We inspired the (right) understanding of the matter: to each (of them) We gave Judgment and Knowledge; it was Our power that made the hills and the birds celebrate Our praises, with David: it was We Who did (all these things)

verses.ar: وَعَلَّمۡنٰهُ صَنۡعَةَ لَبُوۡسٍ لَّكُمۡ لِتُحۡصِنَكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَاۡسِكُمۡۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ شٰكِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: It was We Who taught him the making of coats of mail for your benefit, to guard you from each other's violence: will ye then be grateful

verses.ar: وَلِسُلَيۡمٰنَ الرِّيۡحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجۡرِيۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ٘ اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَاؕ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: (It was Our power that made) the violent (unruly) wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, to his order, to the land which We had blessed: for We do know all things

verses.ar: وَمِنَ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِ مَنۡ يَّغُوۡصُوۡنَ لَهٗ وَيَعۡمَلُوۡنَ عَمَلًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَۚ وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حٰفِظِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And of the evil ones, were some who dived for him, and did other work besides; and it was We Who guarded them

verses.ar: وَاَيُّوۡبَ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنِّيۡ مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَاَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗ فَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهٖ مِنۡ ضُرٍّ وَّاٰتَيۡنٰهُ اَهۡلَهٗ وَمِثۡلَهُمۡ مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا وَذِكۡرٰي لِلۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: So We listened to him: We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his people to him, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who serve Us

verses.ar: وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِدۡرِيۡسَ وَذَا الۡكِفۡلِؕ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَۙۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Isma'il, Idris, and Zul-kifl, all (men) of constancy and patience

verses.ar: وَاَدۡخَلۡنٰهُمۡ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
verses.en: We admitted them to Our mercy: for they were of the righteous ones

verses.ar: وَذَا النُّوۡنِ اِذۡ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ اَنۡ لَّنۡ نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادٰي فِي الظُّلُمٰتِ اَنۡ لَّا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَكَࣗۖ اِنِّيۡ كُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: And remember Zun-nun, when he departed in wrath: He imagined that We had no power over him! But he cried through the deptHs of darkness, "There is no god but thou: glory to thee: I was indeed wrong

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗۙ وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡغَمِّؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُۨجِي الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: So We listened to him: and delivered him from distress: and thus do We deliver those who have faith

verses.ar: وَزَكَرِيَّا٘ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِيۡ فَرۡدًا وَّاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡوٰرِثِيۡنَۚۖ‏
verses.en: And (remember) Zakariya, when he cried to his Lord: "O my Lord! leave me not without offspring, though thou art the best of inheritors

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗؗ وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ يَحۡيٰي وَاَصۡلَحۡنَا لَهٗ زَوۡجَهٗؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يُسٰرِعُوۡنَ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَيَدۡعُوۡنَنَا رَغَبًا وَّرَهَبًاؕ وَكَانُوۡا لَنَا خٰشِعِيۡنَ
verses.en: So We listened to him: and We granted him Yahya: We cured his wife's (Barrenness) for him. These (three) were ever quick in emulation in good works; they used to call on Us with love and reverence, and humble themselves before Us

verses.ar: وَالَّتِيۡ٘ اَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ رُّوۡحِنَا وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا وَابۡنَهَا٘ اٰيَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And (remember) her who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples

verses.ar: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ٘ اُمَّتُكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةًؗۖ وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
verses.en: Verily, this brotherhood of yours is a single brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore serve Me (and no other)

verses.ar: وَتَقَطَّعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ كُلٌّ اِلَيۡنَا رٰجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: But (later generations) cut off their affair (of unity), one from another: (yet) will they all return to Us

verses.ar: فَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهٖۚ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ كٰتِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: Whoever works any act of righteousness and has faith,- His endeavour will not be rejected: We shall record it in his favour

verses.ar: وَحَرٰمٌ عَلٰي قَرۡيَةٍ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهَا٘ اَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: But there is a ban on any population which We have destroyed: that they shall not return

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فُتِحَتۡ يَاۡجُوۡجُ وَمَاۡجُوۡجُ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنۡسِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Until the Gog and Magog (people) are let through (their barrier), and they swiftly swarm from every hill

verses.ar: وَاقۡتَرَبَ الۡوَعۡدُ الۡحَقُّ فَاِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ اَبۡصَارُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاؕ يٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then will the true promise draw nigh (of fulfilment): then behold! the eyes of the Unbelievers will fixedly stare in horror: "Ah! Woe to us! we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we truly did wrong

verses.ar: اِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَؕ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا وٰرِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Verily ye, (unbelievers), and the (false) gods that ye worship besides Allah, are (but) fuel for Hell! to it will ye (surely) come

verses.ar: لَوۡ كَانَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اٰلِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوۡهَاؕ وَكُلٌّ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: If these had been gods, they would not have got there! but each one will abide therein

verses.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا زَفِيۡرٌ وَّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: There, sobbing will be their lot, nor will they there hear (aught else)

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُمۡ مِّنَّا الۡحُسۡنٰ٘يۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Those for whom the good (record) from Us has gone before, will be removed far therefrom

verses.ar: لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ حَسِيۡسَهَاۚ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ مَا اشۡتَهَتۡ اَنۡفُسُهُمۡ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Not the slightest sound will they hear of Hell: what their souls desired, in that will they dwell

verses.ar: لَا يَحۡزُنُهُمُ الۡفَزَعُ الۡاَكۡبَرُ وَتَتَلَقّٰىهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُؕ هٰذَا يَوۡمُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: The Great Terror will bring them no grief: but the angels will meet them (with mutual greetings): "This is your Day,- (the Day) that ye were promised

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي السَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِؕ كَمَا بَدَاۡنَا٘ اَوَّلَ خَلۡقٍ نُّعِيۡدُهٗؕ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: The Day that We roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books (completed),- even as We produced the first creation, so shall We produce a new one: a promise We have undertaken: truly shall We fulfil it

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِي الزَّبُوۡرِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ الذِّكۡرِ اَنَّ الۡاَرۡضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصّٰلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Before this We wrote in the Psalms, after the Message (given to Moses): My servants the righteous, shall inherit the earth

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ هٰذَا لَبَلٰغًا لِّقَوۡمٍ عٰبِدِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Verily in this (Qur'an) is a Message for people who would (truly) worship Allah

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: We sent thee not, but as a Mercy for all creatures

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "What has come to me by inspiration is that your Allah is One Allah: will ye therefore bow to His Will (in Islam)

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَقُلۡ اٰذَنۡتُكُمۡ عَلٰي سَوَآءٍؕ وَاِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ٘ اَقَرِيۡبٌ اَمۡ بَعِيۡدٌ مَّا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: But if they turn back, Say: "I have proclaimed the Message to you all alike and in truth; but I know not whether that which ye are promised is near or far

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ الۡجَهۡرَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡتُمُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is He Who knows what is open in speech and what ye hide (in your hearts)

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ لَعَلَّهٗ فِتۡنَةٌ لَّكُمۡ وَمَتَاعٌ اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
verses.en: I know not but that it may be a trial for you, and a grant of (worldly) livelihood (to you) for a time

verses.ar: قٰلَ رَبِّ احۡكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰي مَا تَصِفُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "O my Lord! judge Thou in truth!" "Our Lord Most Gracious is the One Whose assistance should be sought against the blasphemies ye utter
